currentVersion.description: Current resource version when reporting a version conflict.

details.description: Must never contain secrets or restricted content.

requiresSnapshot.description: Whether the client must re-fetch a snapshot before retrying.

decisionSource.description: The authority that produced this decision. Legacy records predate this field and deserialize as `user`, which is the only decision source they could persist.

oneOf.description: Agent scheduled via `compact.run` / `host_request` (turn-end).

ContextCategoryId.description: Category buckets for model-visible context occupancy.

ContextCategoryUsage.description: One category's share of the current context window occupancy.

shareBps.description: Share in basis points (0..=10_000); categories sum to 10_000 when `total_tokens > 0`.

ContextOccupancy.description:
Category breakdown of how full the effective context window is.

Distinct from billing usage: this answers "what fills the window", not "how much was spent".

ExecOrigin.description: Who initiated a command execution: a model tool call, or the user's `!` shell escape.

FileChangeEntry.description: One file touched by a write/edit/patch tool call.

GitInfo.description: Snapshot semantics: the current value is *copied* into the record at observation time; later changes to the source do not affect the copy.

dirty.description: `None` = unknown (e.g. converted from legacy data that never recorded the dirty flag); fresh snapshots always compute it.

progressSummary.description: Human-readable progress summary; no percentage (a value that cannot be honestly computed does not enter the protocol).

GoalStatus.description: State machine: `active ⇄ paused / blocked / usageLimited / budgetLimited` (the latter two are NOT terminal — topping up quota or resuming returns to `active`); terminal states are `completed / failed / canceled`.

clientUserMessageId.description: Domain-level dedup key: the same logical message materializes only once across steer/queue races and RPC retries.

entry.description: Records the path this message actually took (absorbs the legacy `SteerInput` variant). Input still sitting in the queue is not yet an item of any turn.

oneOf.description: The provider's encrypted reasoning payload is stored by reference and re-attached when building outbound context.
Typed projection of the `update_plan` tool: the tool call/result pair remains the replay truth (hidden from display); this variant is the single UI-facing plan truth and evolves over the whole turn.

callId.description: Tool-call id when this plan item came from an `update_plan` call. Clients key the running tool row by call id; without it the plan completion cannot be correlated and the row stays open forever. `None` for proposed-plan markdown (plan mode) and legacy persisted items written before the field existed.

displayContent.description: Compressed UI rendering; does not change replay semantics.

oneOf.description: Specialized result variant for the exec tool family (`exec_command`/`write_stdin`). Model-initiated shell calls are the majority; user `!` commands land in the same variant with `origin = userShell`. Displaying the command plus prompt replay needs the original model input, hence a dedicated variant.

One logical approval interaction = one item (merges the legacy `ApprovalRequest` + `ApprovalDecision` pair); `decision = None` is the waiting state, filled in place on response.

commandPattern.description: Normalized command pattern used by session-scoped approval labels.

commandPrefix.description: Suggested command prefix for persistent exec-policy approval.

targetItemId.description: Points at the action item being approved (CommandExecution/FileChange/ToolCall).

oneOf.description: Structured questions from a tool (options/forms). Must be persisted so pending questions survive reconnect/resume and remain answerable.
Not merged into `BackgroundTask`: the control planes are disjoint (process stdin/stdout vs. a full session's message channel and permission inheritance). Both share `SpawnedWorkState`.

command.description: User `!` shell command text when `task_kind` is `Shell`.

output.description: Retained stdout/stderr tail for resume / task reads.

oneOf.description: Human-readable milestone summary only; no percentage — a value that cannot be honestly computed does not enter the protocol.
Continual Harness refine outcome (L2-DES-HARNESS-001). Not a memory browser.
Non-fatal events (model retry, capability downgrade, quota pressure) that must leave a trace without failing the turn.

sessionId.description: Owning session: lets subscribers route child-session deltas (subagent monitor) instead of folding them into the main transcript.

parentId.description: Parent in the session transcript tree (`None` = root). Legacy lines omit the field; readers infer a linear chain by `seq` when missing.

revision.description: Strictly increasing per `id`; `1` on first appearance. Readers fold updates by `(id, revision)`.

seq.description: Sequence position assigned on first appearance; strictly increasing within a session. Later updates reuse the same `seq`.

variant.description: Optional named variant from the provider model directory.

ModelQueryRetryPhase.description: Phase of a provider retry cycle (ratified vocabulary, L2-DES-APP-009 DD-3): a retry is first `Scheduled`, then `Resumed` when the next attempt starts.

oneOf.description: Promoted out of the queue into the running turn as a steer.
Dequeued to start its own new turn.

input.description: Full editable content; `session/queue/update` replaces it wholesale.

preview.description: Short single-line preview for list rendering.

ReasoningEffort.description: OpenAI models support reasoning effort. See <https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/reasoning?api-mode=responses#get-started-with-reasoning>

SandboxExecutionSummary.description: Compact description of how a sandboxed execution ran.

escalated.description: Whether the execution ran outside the sandbox after approval.

schedule.description: Cron / "every 5m"-style expression when [`Self::kind`] is Cron or when the heartbeat was created from a schedule string.

activeTurnId.description: Invariant: `status == Active` iff `active_turn_id.is_some()`; updated atomically by the single session actor.

activity.description: Agents View / list tray activity. Server-maintained from `status` + `flags` so clients do not re-derive (L2-DES-RLM-001 Agents View).

additionalDirectories.description: Additional absolute workspace roots associated with the session.

atTurnId.description: Cut turn for a user fork (`through` that turn); absent for tip forks.

cwd.description: Execution scope of the session: normalized absolute path. It is part of the session's identity, not the client's location; resuming from a different cwd does not change it.

flags.description: Stackable blocking reasons; deduplicated and serialized in enum order so equivalent snapshots produce stable JSON.

forkFromId.description: Source session when this session was created by user `session/fork`.

gitInfo.description: Computed at creation and recomputed on `session/cwd/change`; clients treat it as potentially stale.

messageCount.description: Approximate user+assistant item count for list / Agents View trays. Optional so older snapshots and non-list reads stay compact.

model.description: Current binding: what the next turn will use.

parent.description: Sub-agent parent only. User forks use `fork_from_id` instead.

queuedCount.description: The queue is session state, not turn state.

summary.description: Idle-session summary line for Agents View (may be stale).

taskState.description: Coarse task/agent state label when known (`idle`, `working`, …).

transcriptSizeBytes.description: Current on-disk size of the durable JSONL transcript. This is a list-view cache: servers may omit it from non-list responses or when the session has no readable rollout file.

usage.description: Redundant aggregate of turn usages for list views; the ledger wins on any disagreement.

SessionActivity.description: List / Agents View activity. Derived from [`SessionStatus`] + [`SessionFlag`] on the server (`Session::sync_activity`) so first-party clients read it directly from Native wire — no client-side projection adapters.

SessionFlag.description: Blocking reasons, stackable on top of `status`. "Waiting" is a flag, not a status: clients can tell "working" apart from "blocked on you".

oneOf.description: A pending approval request.
An unanswered structured question.
Compaction in progress.
Goal-internal orchestration in progress.

SessionParent.description: Sub-agent parentage only. User forks use `Session.fork_from_id` / `Session.at_turn_id` so list/delete/resume treat them as independent parallel history rather than child executors.

autoRefineEnabled.description: Root auto-refine enable (default on when unset). Persist-first via patch.

autoRefineTurnInterval.description: Successful user-visible turns between auto-refine runs (default 25).

effectiveContextWindow.description: Session override for the absolute effective context window (tokens). When set, takes precedence over the model-derived effective window and is clamped to `model.context_window` at resolve time. Also drives the automatic-compaction boundary.

mode.description: ACP-style session mode id, if one is active.

pythonCellFirstWaitMs.description: First foreground wait (ms) before Python cell wait-policy. Default 180_000 when unset.

reasoningEffort.description: User's reasoning-effort selection as persisted, including the toggle keywords `on`/`off` used by toggle/variant-style models — the typed `ReasoningEffort` enum cannot express those, so the snapshot carries the raw selection string (same contract as `SessionSettingsPatch.reasoning_effort`).

sandboxProfile.description: Active sandbox profile description; needed to restore the sandbox when resuming the session.

oneOf.description: Truncated first user message applied before optional LLM polish.

SessionUsage.description: Derived cache aggregated from the usage ledger (truth = ledger sum). Exists solely so list views need not page through turn details; on any disagreement the ledger wins.

legacy.description: Pre-upgrade historical totals that cannot be decomposed into calls; not disguised as call records. `total = legacy + ledger`.

SpawnedWorkState.description: State of spawned external work referenced by `SubAgent`/`BackgroundTask`. Distinct from the parent item envelope's delivery lifecycle. `Lost` makes spawned work whose terminal state cannot be confirmed after a runtime restart recognizable instead of pretending it completed.

collaborationMode.description: Collaboration mode captured for this turn. Older servers may omit it; clients may then fall back to the session's current mode.

model.description: Snapshot: the binding this turn actually ran with. `session.model` may change afterwards; history must faithfully answer "what did this turn run with".

TurnKind.description:
Completion invariants are defined per kind (07 §4.3): all kinds require foreground items terminal and no pending approval/question; `Regular` and `GoalContinuation` successes additionally require a final assistant message; `Compaction` requires a terminal `ContextCompaction` instead.

v1 keeps exactly three variants: the legacy `Review` kind was dead code and an open `Other(String)` variant breaks exhaustive client matching.

oneOf.description: Goal-driven autonomous turn. Has no user message by design and is not steerable; only `Regular + InProgress` turns may be steered.

TurnRecovery.description: A saved turn can be recoverable without any live execution task.

oneOf.description: Execution is paused until a first-party approval decision arrives.

TurnUsage.description: Split so that "how much did this turn cost" and "the bill" reconcile: `query` covers only `TurnQuery`; `overhead` covers the turn's `AutoReview + Compaction`.

oneOf.description: Main loop, including model retries and post-tool follow-ups.
Model reviewer before approval.
History compaction summary.
Session title generation.
Continual Harness refine planning (`L2-DES-HARNESS-001`).
Mid-tool Python cell wait-policy decision.

UsageTotals.description: Aggregated token/call totals. `call_count` includes failed and cancelled attempts; `metered_call_count` counts attempts with reported usage.

totalTokens.description: Aggregate tokens. For ledger-derived totals this equals `input_tokens + output_tokens`; for legacy lumps it is the only known number (the input/output split was never recorded).

UserInput.description: One submission = one `UserMessage` item whose content is a list of parts.

oneOf.description: Experimental; not part of the v1 guaranteed modalities.

UserMessageEntry.description: How a user message entered the system.

oneOf.description: Submitted while idle; immediately started a new turn.
Submitted while busy into the queue; started its own turn when drained.
Injected into a running turn (including promotion from the queue).

v1 keeps exactly three variants: the legacy `Review` kind was dead code and an open `Other(String)` variant breaks exhaustive client matching.

oneOf.description: Goal-driven autonomous turn. Has no user message by design and is not steerable; only `Regular + InProgress` turns may be steered.

TurnRecovery.description: A saved turn can be recoverable without any live execution task.

oneOf.description: Execution is paused until a first-party approval decision arrives.

TurnUsage.description: Split so that "how much did this turn cost" and "the bill" reconcile: `query` covers only `TurnQuery`; `overhead` covers the turn's `AutoReview + Compaction`.

oneOf.description: Main loop, including model retries and post-tool follow-ups.
Model reviewer before approval.
History compaction summary.
Session title generation.
Continual Harness refine planning (`L2-DES-HARNESS-001`).
Mid-tool Python cell wait-policy decision.

UsageTotals.description: Aggregated token/call totals. `call_count` includes failed and cancelled attempts; `metered_call_count` counts attempts with reported usage.

totalTokens.description: Aggregate tokens. For ledger-derived totals this equals `input_tokens + output_tokens`; for legacy lumps it is the only known number (the input/output split was never recorded).

UserInput.description: One submission = one `UserMessage` item whose content is a list of parts.

oneOf.description: Experimental; not part of the v1 guaranteed modalities.

UserMessageEntry.description: How a user message entered the system.

oneOf.description: Submitted while idle; immediately started a new turn.
Submitted while busy into the queue; started its own turn when drained.
Injected into a running turn (including promotion from the queue).

currentVersion.description: Current resource version when reporting a version conflict.

details.description: Must never contain secrets or restricted content.

requiresSnapshot.description: Whether the client must re-fetch a snapshot before retrying.

decisionSource.description: The authority that produced this decision. Legacy records predate this field and deserialize as `user`, which is the only decision source they could persist.

BackgroundTaskKind.description: v1 only has shell background tasks; new kinds are backward-compatible variant additions.

oneOf.description: Agent scheduled via `compact.run` / `host_request` (turn-end).

ContextCategoryId.description: Category buckets for model-visible context occupancy.

ContextCategoryUsage.description: One category's share of the current context window occupancy.

shareBps.description: Share in basis points (0..=10_000); categories sum to 10_000 when `total_tokens > 0`.

ContextOccupancy.description:
Category breakdown of how full the effective context window is.

Distinct from billing usage: this answers "what fills the window", not "how much was spent".

ContextUsage.description:
Context-window occupancy snapshot (distinct from billing usage, see the usage module). `measured = false` marks parts that were not precisely metered.

Used on compaction items (`before` / `after`). Prefer [`ContextOccupancy`] for `context/usage/read` and `context/usageUpdated`.

ExecOrigin.description: Who initiated a command execution: a model tool call, or the user's `!` shell escape.

FileChangeEntry.description: One file touched by a write/edit/patch tool call.

GitInfo.description: Snapshot semantics: the current value is *copied* into the record at observation time; later changes to the source do not affect the copy.

dirty.description: `None` = unknown (e.g. converted from legacy data that never recorded the dirty flag); fresh snapshots always compute it.

progressSummary.description: Human-readable progress summary; no percentage (a value that cannot be honestly computed does not enter the protocol).

GoalStatus.description: State machine: `active ⇄ paused / blocked / usageLimited / budgetLimited` (the latter two are NOT terminal — topping up quota or resuming returns to `active`); terminal states are `completed / failed / canceled`.

clientUserMessageId.description: Domain-level dedup key: the same logical message materializes only once across steer/queue races and RPC retries.

entry.description: Records the path this message actually took (absorbs the legacy `SteerInput` variant). Input still sitting in the queue is not yet an item of any turn.

oneOf.description: The provider's encrypted reasoning payload is stored by reference and re-attached when building outbound context.
Typed projection of the `update_plan` tool: the tool call/result pair remains the replay truth (hidden from display); this variant is the single UI-facing plan truth and evolves over the whole turn.

callId.description: Tool-call id when this plan item came from an `update_plan` call. Clients key the running tool row by call id; without it the plan completion cannot be correlated and the row stays open forever. `None` for proposed-plan markdown (plan mode) and legacy persisted items written before the field existed.

displayContent.description: Compressed UI rendering; does not change replay semantics.

oneOf.description: Specialized result variant for the exec tool family (`exec_command`/`write_stdin`). Model-initiated shell calls are the majority; user `!` commands land in the same variant with `origin = userShell`. Displaying the command plus prompt replay needs the original model input, hence a dedicated variant.
Generalizes the legacy `WebSearch`/`ImageGeneration` variants: future provider-hosted tools (code_interpreter, ...) need zero protocol changes; clients render by `tool_name`.
Specialized result for the write/edit/patch tool family. Per-file granularity (one apply_patch may touch many files), approval is per change, and a stable item lets diff-review UIs update in place.
One logical approval interaction = one item (merges the legacy `ApprovalRequest` + `ApprovalDecision` pair); `decision = None` is the waiting state, filled in place on response.

commandPattern.description: Normalized command pattern used by session-scoped approval labels.

commandPrefix.description: Suggested command prefix for persistent exec-policy approval.

targetItemId.description: Points at the action item being approved (CommandExecution/FileChange/ToolCall).

oneOf.description: Structured questions from a tool (options/forms). Must be persisted so pending questions survive reconnect/resume and remain answerable.
Not merged into `BackgroundTask`: the control planes are disjoint (process stdin/stdout vs. a full session's message channel and permission inheritance). Both share `SpawnedWorkState`.

command.description: User `!` shell command text when `task_kind` is `Shell`.

output.description: Retained stdout/stderr tail for resume / task reads.

oneOf.description: Human-readable milestone summary only; no percentage — a value that cannot be honestly computed does not enter the protocol.
Continual Harness refine outcome (L2-DES-HARNESS-001). Not a memory browser.
Non-fatal events (model retry, capability downgrade, quota pressure) that must leave a trace without failing the turn.
Summary of an abandoned branch after in-session tree navigate (`branch_summary` item). Tree-visible; parent is the new leaf.

sessionId.description: Owning session: lets subscribers route child-session deltas (subagent monitor) instead of folding them into the main transcript.

ItemEnvelope.description: Persistence-and-event shared header for every item. The item payload does not embed an id; identity, ordering, revision and the common lifecycle state live here.

parentId.description: Parent in the session transcript tree (`None` = root). Legacy lines omit the field; readers infer a linear chain by `seq` when missing.

revision.description: Strictly increasing per `id`; `1` on first appearance. Readers fold updates by `(id, revision)`.

seq.description: Sequence position assigned on first appearance; strictly increasing within a session. Later updates reuse the same `seq`.

ItemState.description: Common delivery lifecycle of an item, owned by the envelope. Variants must not duplicate their own status field (linked-work state on `SubAgent`/`BackgroundTask` describes the external work, not delivery).

variant.description: Optional named variant from the provider model directory.

ModelQueryRetryPhase.description: Phase of a provider retry cycle (ratified vocabulary, L2-DES-APP-009 DD-3): a retry is first `Scheduled`, then `Resumed` when the next attempt starts.

oneOf.description: Promoted out of the queue into the running turn as a steer.
Dequeued to start its own new turn.

input.description: Full editable content; `session/queue/update` replaces it wholesale.

preview.description: Short single-line preview for list rendering.

ReasoningEffort.description: OpenAI models support reasoning effort. See <https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/reasoning?api-mode=responses#get-started-with-reasoning>

SandboxExecutionSummary.description: Compact description of how a sandboxed execution ran.

escalated.description: Whether the execution ran outside the sandbox after approval.

schedule.description: Cron / "every 5m"-style expression when [`Self::kind`] is Cron or when the heartbeat was created from a schedule string.

activeTurnId.description: Invariant: `status == Active` iff `active_turn_id.is_some()`; updated atomically by the single session actor.

activity.description: Agents View / list tray activity. Server-maintained from `status` + `flags` so clients do not re-derive (L2-DES-RLM-001 Agents View).

additionalDirectories.description: Additional absolute workspace roots associated with the session.

atTurnId.description: Cut turn for a user fork (`through` that turn); absent for tip forks.

cwd.description: Execution scope of the session: normalized absolute path. It is part of the session's identity, not the client's location; resuming from a different cwd does not change it.

flags.description: Stackable blocking reasons; deduplicated and serialized in enum order so equivalent snapshots produce stable JSON.

forkFromId.description: Source session when this session was created by user `session/fork`.

gitInfo.description: Computed at creation and recomputed on `session/cwd/change`; clients treat it as potentially stale.

messageCount.description: Approximate user+assistant item count for list / Agents View trays. Optional so older snapshots and non-list reads stay compact.

model.description: Current binding: what the next turn will use.

parent.description: Sub-agent parent only. User forks use `fork_from_id` instead.

queuedCount.description: The queue is session state, not turn state.

summary.description: Idle-session summary line for Agents View (may be stale).

taskState.description: Coarse task/agent state label when known (`idle`, `working`, …).

transcriptSizeBytes.description: Current on-disk size of the durable JSONL transcript. This is a list-view cache: servers may omit it from non-list responses or when the session has no readable rollout file.

usage.description: Redundant aggregate of turn usages for list views; the ledger wins on any disagreement.

SessionActivity.description: List / Agents View activity. Derived from [`SessionStatus`] + [`SessionFlag`] on the server (`Session::sync_activity`) so first-party clients read it directly from Native wire — no client-side projection adapters.

SessionFlag.description: Blocking reasons, stackable on top of `status`. "Waiting" is a flag, not a status: clients can tell "working" apart from "blocked on you".

oneOf.description: A pending approval request.
An unanswered structured question.
Compaction in progress.
Goal-internal orchestration in progress.

SessionParent.description: Sub-agent parentage only. User forks use `Session.fork_from_id` / `Session.at_turn_id` so list/delete/resume treat them as independent parallel history rather than child executors.

autoRefineEnabled.description: Root auto-refine enable (default on when unset). Persist-first via patch.

autoRefineTurnInterval.description: Successful user-visible turns between auto-refine runs (default 25).

effectiveContextWindow.description: Session override for the absolute effective context window (tokens). When set, takes precedence over the model-derived effective window and is clamped to `model.context_window` at resolve time. Also drives the automatic-compaction boundary.

mode.description: ACP-style session mode id, if one is active.

pythonCellFirstWaitMs.description: First foreground wait (ms) before Python cell wait-policy. Default 180_000 when unset.

reasoningEffort.description: User's reasoning-effort selection as persisted, including the toggle keywords `on`/`off` used by toggle/variant-style models — the typed `ReasoningEffort` enum cannot express those, so the snapshot carries the raw selection string (same contract as `SessionSettingsPatch.reasoning_effort`).

sandboxProfile.description: Active sandbox profile description; needed to restore the sandbox when resuming the session.

oneOf.description: Truncated first user message applied before optional LLM polish.

SessionUsage.description: Derived cache aggregated from the usage ledger (truth = ledger sum). Exists solely so list views need not page through turn details; on any disagreement the ledger wins.

legacy.description: Pre-upgrade historical totals that cannot be decomposed into calls; not disguised as call records. `total = legacy + ledger`.

SpawnedWorkState.description: State of spawned external work referenced by `SubAgent`/`BackgroundTask`. Distinct from the parent item envelope's delivery lifecycle. `Lost` makes spawned work whose terminal state cannot be confirmed after a runtime restart recognizable instead of pretending it completed.

collaborationMode.description: Collaboration mode captured for this turn. Older servers may omit it; clients may then fall back to the session's current mode.

model.description: Snapshot: the binding this turn actually ran with. `session.model` may change afterwards; history must faithfully answer "what did this turn run with".

displayContent.description: Compressed UI rendering; does not change replay semantics.

oneOf.description: Specialized result variant for the exec tool family (`exec_command`/`write_stdin`). Model-initiated shell calls are the majority; user `!` commands land in the same variant with `origin = userShell`. Displaying the command plus prompt replay needs the original model input, hence a dedicated variant.
Generalizes the legacy `WebSearch`/`ImageGeneration` variants: future provider-hosted tools (code_interpreter, ...) need zero protocol changes; clients render by `tool_name`.
Specialized result for the write/edit/patch tool family. Per-file granularity (one apply_patch may touch many files), approval is per change, and a stable item lets diff-review UIs update in place.
One logical approval interaction = one item (merges the legacy `ApprovalRequest` + `ApprovalDecision` pair); `decision = None` is the waiting state, filled in place on response.

commandPattern.description: Normalized command pattern used by session-scoped approval labels.

commandPrefix.description: Suggested command prefix for persistent exec-policy approval.

targetItemId.description: Points at the action item being approved (CommandExecution/FileChange/ToolCall).

oneOf.description: Structured questions from a tool (options/forms). Must be persisted so pending questions survive reconnect/resume and remain answerable.

command.description: User `!` shell command text when `task_kind` is `Shell`.

output.description: Retained stdout/stderr tail for resume / task reads.

sessionId.description: Owning session: lets subscribers route child-session deltas (subagent monitor) instead of folding them into the main transcript.

revision.description: Strictly increasing per `id`; `1` on first appearance. Readers fold updates by `(id, revision)`.

seq.description: Sequence position assigned on first appearance; strictly increasing within a session. Later updates reuse the same `seq`.

variant.description: Optional named variant from the provider model directory.

additionalDirectories.description: Additional absolute workspace roots associated with the session.

atTurnId.description: Cut turn for a user fork (`through` that turn); absent for tip forks.

flags.description: Stackable blocking reasons; deduplicated and serialized in enum order so equivalent snapshots produce stable JSON.

forkFromId.description: Source session when this session was created by user `session/fork`.

messageCount.description: Approximate user+assistant item count for list / Agents View trays. Optional so older snapshots and non-list reads stay compact.

model.description: Current binding: what the next turn will use.

parent.description: Sub-agent parent only. User forks use `fork_from_id` instead.

queuedCount.description: The queue is session state, not turn state.

summary.description: Idle-session summary line for Agents View (may be stale).

taskState.description: Coarse task/agent state label when known (`idle`, `working`, …).

transcriptSizeBytes.description: Current on-disk size of the durable JSONL transcript. This is a list-view cache: servers may omit it from non-list responses or when the session has no readable rollout file.

usage.description: Redundant aggregate of turn usages for list views; the ledger wins on any disagreement.

autoRefineEnabled.description: Root auto-refine enable (default on when unset). Persist-first via patch.

autoRefineTurnInterval.description: Successful user-visible turns between auto-refine runs (default 25).

mode.description: ACP-style session mode id, if one is active.

pythonCellFirstWaitMs.description: First foreground wait (ms) before Python cell wait-policy. Default 180_000 when unset.

reasoningEffort.description: User's reasoning-effort selection as persisted, including the toggle keywords `on`/`off` used by toggle/variant-style models — the typed `ReasoningEffort` enum cannot express those, so the snapshot carries the raw selection string (same contract as `SessionSettingsPatch.reasoning_effort`).

sandboxProfile.description: Active sandbox profile description; needed to restore the sandbox when resuming the session.

oneOf.description: Truncated first user message applied before optional LLM polish.

legacy.description: Pre-upgrade historical totals that cannot be decomposed into calls; not disguised as call records. `total = legacy + ledger`.

collaborationMode.description: Collaboration mode captured for this turn. Older servers may omit it; clients may then fall back to the session's current mode.

model.description: Snapshot: the binding this turn actually ran with. `session.model` may change afterwards; history must faithfully answer "what did this turn run with".

TurnKind.description:
Completion invariants are defined per kind (07 §4.3): all kinds require foreground items terminal and no pending approval/question; `Regular` and `GoalContinuation` successes additionally require a final assistant message; `Compaction` requires a terminal `ContextCompaction` instead.

v1 keeps exactly three variants: the legacy `Review` kind was dead code and an open `Other(String)` variant breaks exhaustive client matching.

TurnUsage.description: Split so that "how much did this turn cost" and "the bill" reconcile: `query` covers only `TurnQuery`; `overhead` covers the turn's `AutoReview + Compaction`.

oneOf.description: Main loop, including model retries and post-tool follow-ups.

UserInput.description: One submission = one `UserMessage` item whose content is a list of parts.

activity.description: Agents View / list tray activity. Server-maintained from `status` + `flags` so clients do not re-derive (L2-DES-RLM-001 Agents View).

additionalDirectories.description: Additional absolute workspace roots associated with the session.

atTurnId.description: Cut turn for a user fork (`through` that turn); absent for tip forks.

cwd.description: Execution scope of the session: normalized absolute path. It is part of the session's identity, not the client's location; resuming from a different cwd does not change it.

flags.description: Stackable blocking reasons; deduplicated and serialized in enum order so equivalent snapshots produce stable JSON.

forkFromId.description: Source session when this session was created by user `session/fork`.

gitInfo.description: Computed at creation and recomputed on `session/cwd/change`; clients treat it as potentially stale.

messageCount.description: Approximate user+assistant item count for list / Agents View trays. Optional so older snapshots and non-list reads stay compact.

model.description: Current binding: what the next turn will use.

parent.description: Sub-agent parent only. User forks use `fork_from_id` instead.

queuedCount.description: The queue is session state, not turn state.

summary.description: Idle-session summary line for Agents View (may be stale).

taskState.description: Coarse task/agent state label when known (`idle`, `working`, …).

transcriptSizeBytes.description: Current on-disk size of the durable JSONL transcript. This is a list-view cache: servers may omit it from non-list responses or when the session has no readable rollout file.

usage.description: Redundant aggregate of turn usages for list views; the ledger wins on any disagreement.

SessionActivity.description: List / Agents View activity. Derived from [`SessionStatus`] + [`SessionFlag`] on the server (`Session::sync_activity`) so first-party clients read it directly from Native wire — no client-side projection adapters.

SessionFlag.description: Blocking reasons, stackable on top of `status`. "Waiting" is a flag, not a status: clients can tell "working" apart from "blocked on you".

oneOf.description: A pending approval request.
An unanswered structured question.
Compaction in progress.
Goal-internal orchestration in progress.

SessionParent.description: Sub-agent parentage only. User forks use `Session.fork_from_id` / `Session.at_turn_id` so list/delete/resume treat them as independent parallel history rather than child executors.

autoRefineEnabled.description: Root auto-refine enable (default on when unset). Persist-first via patch.

autoRefineTurnInterval.description: Successful user-visible turns between auto-refine runs (default 25).

effectiveContextWindow.description: Session override for the absolute effective context window (tokens). When set, takes precedence over the model-derived effective window and is clamped to `model.context_window` at resolve time. Also drives the automatic-compaction boundary.

mode.description: ACP-style session mode id, if one is active.

pythonCellFirstWaitMs.description: First foreground wait (ms) before Python cell wait-policy. Default 180_000 when unset.

reasoningEffort.description: User's reasoning-effort selection as persisted, including the toggle keywords `on`/`off` used by toggle/variant-style models — the typed `ReasoningEffort` enum cannot express those, so the snapshot carries the raw selection string (same contract as `SessionSettingsPatch.reasoning_effort`).

sandboxProfile.description: Active sandbox profile description; needed to restore the sandbox when resuming the session.

oneOf.description: Truncated first user message applied before optional LLM polish.

SessionUsage.description: Derived cache aggregated from the usage ledger (truth = ledger sum). Exists solely so list views need not page through turn details; on any disagreement the ledger wins.

legacy.description: Pre-upgrade historical totals that cannot be decomposed into calls; not disguised as call records. `total = legacy + ledger`.

SpawnedWorkState.description: State of spawned external work referenced by `SubAgent`/`BackgroundTask`. Distinct from the parent item envelope's delivery lifecycle. `Lost` makes spawned work whose terminal state cannot be confirmed after a runtime restart recognizable instead of pretending it completed.

collaborationMode.description: Collaboration mode captured for this turn. Older servers may omit it; clients may then fall back to the session's current mode.

model.description: Snapshot: the binding this turn actually ran with. `session.model` may change afterwards; history must faithfully answer "what did this turn run with".

TurnKind.description:
Completion invariants are defined per kind (07 §4.3): all kinds require foreground items terminal and no pending approval/question; `Regular` and `GoalContinuation` successes additionally require a final assistant message; `Compaction` requires a terminal `ContextCompaction` instead.

v1 keeps exactly three variants: the legacy `Review` kind was dead code and an open `Other(String)` variant breaks exhaustive client matching.

oneOf.description: Goal-driven autonomous turn. Has no user message by design and is not steerable; only `Regular + InProgress` turns may be steered.

TurnRecovery.description: A saved turn can be recoverable without any live execution task.

oneOf.description: Execution is paused until a first-party approval decision arrives.

TurnUsage.description: Split so that "how much did this turn cost" and "the bill" reconcile: `query` covers only `TurnQuery`; `overhead` covers the turn's `AutoReview + Compaction`.

oneOf.description: Main loop, including model retries and post-tool follow-ups.
Model reviewer before approval.
History compaction summary.
Session title generation.
Continual Harness refine planning (`L2-DES-HARNESS-001`).
Mid-tool Python cell wait-policy decision.

UsageTotals.description: Aggregated token/call totals. `call_count` includes failed and cancelled attempts; `metered_call_count` counts attempts with reported usage.

totalTokens.description: Aggregate tokens. For ledger-derived totals this equals `input_tokens + output_tokens`; for legacy lumps it is the only known number (the input/output split was never recorded).

UserInput.description: One submission = one `UserMessage` item whose content is a list of parts.

oneOf.description: Experimental; not part of the v1 guaranteed modalities.

UserMessageEntry.description: How a user message entered the system.

oneOf.description: Submitted while idle; immediately started a new turn.
Submitted while busy into the queue; started its own turn when drained.
Injected into a running turn (including promotion from the queue).

currentVersion.description: Current resource version when reporting a version conflict.

details.description: Must never contain secrets or restricted content.

requiresSnapshot.description: Whether the client must re-fetch a snapshot before retrying.

decisionSource.description: The authority that produced this decision. Legacy records predate this field and deserialize as `user`, which is the only decision source they could persist.

BackgroundTaskKind.description: v1 only has shell background tasks; new kinds are backward-compatible variant additions.

oneOf.description: Agent scheduled via `compact.run` / `host_request` (turn-end).

ContextCategoryId.description: Category buckets for model-visible context occupancy.

ContextCategoryUsage.description: One category's share of the current context window occupancy.

shareBps.description: Share in basis points (0..=10_000); categories sum to 10_000 when `total_tokens > 0`.

ContextOccupancy.description:
Category breakdown of how full the effective context window is.

Distinct from billing usage: this answers "what fills the window", not "how much was spent".

ContextUsage.description:
Context-window occupancy snapshot (distinct from billing usage, see the usage module). `measured = false` marks parts that were not precisely metered.

Used on compaction items (`before` / `after`). Prefer [`ContextOccupancy`] for `context/usage/read` and `context/usageUpdated`.

ExecOrigin.description: Who initiated a command execution: a model tool call, or the user's `!` shell escape.

FileChangeEntry.description: One file touched by a write/edit/patch tool call.

GitInfo.description: Snapshot semantics: the current value is *copied* into the record at observation time; later changes to the source do not affect the copy.

dirty.description: `None` = unknown (e.g. converted from legacy data that never recorded the dirty flag); fresh snapshots always compute it.

progressSummary.description: Human-readable progress summary; no percentage (a value that cannot be honestly computed does not enter the protocol).

GoalStatus.description: State machine: `active ⇄ paused / blocked / usageLimited / budgetLimited` (the latter two are NOT terminal — topping up quota or resuming returns to `active`); terminal states are `completed / failed / canceled`.

clientUserMessageId.description: Domain-level dedup key: the same logical message materializes only once across steer/queue races and RPC retries.

entry.description: Records the path this message actually took (absorbs the legacy `SteerInput` variant). Input still sitting in the queue is not yet an item of any turn.

oneOf.description: The provider's encrypted reasoning payload is stored by reference and re-attached when building outbound context.
Typed projection of the `update_plan` tool: the tool call/result pair remains the replay truth (hidden from display); this variant is the single UI-facing plan truth and evolves over the whole turn.

callId.description: Tool-call id when this plan item came from an `update_plan` call. Clients key the running tool row by call id; without it the plan completion cannot be correlated and the row stays open forever. `None` for proposed-plan markdown (plan mode) and legacy persisted items written before the field existed.

displayContent.description: Compressed UI rendering; does not change replay semantics.

oneOf.description: Specialized result variant for the exec tool family (`exec_command`/`write_stdin`). Model-initiated shell calls are the majority; user `!` commands land in the same variant with `origin = userShell`. Displaying the command plus prompt replay needs the original model input, hence a dedicated variant.
Generalizes the legacy `WebSearch`/`ImageGeneration` variants: future provider-hosted tools (code_interpreter, ...) need zero protocol changes; clients render by `tool_name`.
Specialized result for the write/edit/patch tool family. Per-file granularity (one apply_patch may touch many files), approval is per change, and a stable item lets diff-review UIs update in place.
One logical approval interaction = one item (merges the legacy `ApprovalRequest` + `ApprovalDecision` pair); `decision = None` is the waiting state, filled in place on response.

commandPrefix.description: Suggested command prefix for persistent exec-policy approval.

targetItemId.description: Points at the action item being approved (CommandExecution/FileChange/ToolCall).

oneOf.description: Structured questions from a tool (options/forms). Must be persisted so pending questions survive reconnect/resume and remain answerable.
Not merged into `BackgroundTask`: the control planes are disjoint (process stdin/stdout vs. a full session's message channel and permission inheritance). Both share `SpawnedWorkState`.

Summary of an abandoned branch after in-session tree navigate (`branch_summary` item). Tree-visible; parent is the new leaf.

activity.description: Agents View / list tray activity. Server-maintained from `status` + `flags` so clients do not re-derive (L2-DES-RLM-001 Agents View).

additionalDirectories.description: Additional absolute workspace roots associated with the session.

atTurnId.description: Cut turn for a user fork (`through` that turn); absent for tip forks.

cwd.description: Execution scope of the session: normalized absolute path. It is part of the session's identity, not the client's location; resuming from a different cwd does not change it.

flags.description: Stackable blocking reasons; deduplicated and serialized in enum order so equivalent snapshots produce stable JSON.

forkFromId.description: Source session when this session was created by user `session/fork`.

gitInfo.description: Computed at creation and recomputed on `session/cwd/change`; clients treat it as potentially stale.

messageCount.description: Approximate user+assistant item count for list / Agents View trays. Optional so older snapshots and non-list reads stay compact.

model.description: Current binding: what the next turn will use.

parent.description: Sub-agent parent only. User forks use `fork_from_id` instead.

queuedCount.description: The queue is session state, not turn state.

summary.description: Idle-session summary line for Agents View (may be stale).

taskState.description: Coarse task/agent state label when known (`idle`, `working`, …).

transcriptSizeBytes.description: Current on-disk size of the durable JSONL transcript. This is a list-view cache: servers may omit it from non-list responses or when the session has no readable rollout file.

usage.description: Redundant aggregate of turn usages for list views; the ledger wins on any disagreement.

SessionActivity.description: List / Agents View activity. Derived from [`SessionStatus`] + [`SessionFlag`] on the server (`Session::sync_activity`) so first-party clients read it directly from Native wire — no client-side projection adapters.

SessionFlag.description: Blocking reasons, stackable on top of `status`. "Waiting" is a flag, not a status: clients can tell "working" apart from "blocked on you".

oneOf.description: A pending approval request.
An unanswered structured question.
Compaction in progress.
Goal-internal orchestration in progress.

SessionParent.description: Sub-agent parentage only. User forks use `Session.fork_from_id` / `Session.at_turn_id` so list/delete/resume treat them as independent parallel history rather than child executors.

autoRefineEnabled.description: Root auto-refine enable (default on when unset). Persist-first via patch.

autoRefineTurnInterval.description: Successful user-visible turns between auto-refine runs (default 25).

effectiveContextWindow.description: Session override for the absolute effective context window (tokens). When set, takes precedence over the model-derived effective window and is clamped to `model.context_window` at resolve time. Also drives the automatic-compaction boundary.

mode.description: ACP-style session mode id, if one is active.

pythonCellFirstWaitMs.description: First foreground wait (ms) before Python cell wait-policy. Default 180_000 when unset.

reasoningEffort.description: User's reasoning-effort selection as persisted, including the toggle keywords `on`/`off` used by toggle/variant-style models — the typed `ReasoningEffort` enum cannot express those, so the snapshot carries the raw selection string (same contract as `SessionSettingsPatch.reasoning_effort`).

sandboxProfile.description: Active sandbox profile description; needed to restore the sandbox when resuming the session.

oneOf.description: Truncated first user message applied before optional LLM polish.

SessionUsage.description: Derived cache aggregated from the usage ledger (truth = ledger sum). Exists solely so list views need not page through turn details; on any disagreement the ledger wins.

legacy.description: Pre-upgrade historical totals that cannot be decomposed into calls; not disguised as call records. `total = legacy + ledger`.

Distinct from the parent item envelope's delivery lifecycle. `Lost` makes spawned work whose terminal state cannot be confirmed after a runtime restart recognizable instead of pretending it completed.

collaborationMode.description: Collaboration mode captured for this turn. Older servers may omit it; clients may then fall back to the session's current mode.

model.description: Snapshot: the binding this turn actually ran with. `session.model` may change afterwards; history must faithfully answer "what did this turn run with".

TurnKind.description:
Completion invariants are defined per kind (07 §4.3): all kinds require foreground items terminal and no pending approval/question; `Regular` and `GoalContinuation` successes additionally require a final assistant message; `Compaction` requires a terminal `ContextCompaction` instead.

v1 keeps exactly three variants: the legacy `Review` kind was dead code and an open `Other(String)` variant breaks exhaustive client matching.

oneOf.description: Goal-driven autonomous turn. Has no user message by design and is not steerable; only `Regular + InProgress` turns may be steered.

TurnRecovery.description: A saved turn can be recoverable without any live execution task.

oneOf.description: Execution is paused until a first-party approval decision arrives.

TurnUsage.description: Split so that "how much did this turn cost" and "the bill" reconcile: `query` covers only `TurnQuery`; `overhead` covers the turn's `AutoReview + Compaction`.

oneOf.description: Main loop, including model retries and post-tool follow-ups.

History compaction summary.

UsageTotals.description: Aggregated token/call totals. `call_count` includes failed and cancelled attempts; `metered_call_count` counts attempts with reported usage.

totalTokens.description: Aggregate tokens. For ledger-derived totals this equals `input_tokens + output_tokens`; for legacy lumps it is the only known number (the input/output split was never recorded).

UserInput.description: One submission = one `UserMessage` item whose content is a list of parts.

oneOf.description: Experimental; not part of the v1 guaranteed modalities.

UserMessageEntry.description: How a user message entered the system.

oneOf.description: Submitted while idle; immediately started a new turn.
Submitted while busy into the queue; started its own turn when drained.
Injected into a running turn (including promotion from the queue).

currentVersion.description: Current resource version when reporting a version conflict.

details.description: Must never contain secrets or restricted content.

requiresSnapshot.description: Whether the client must re-fetch a snapshot before retrying.

decisionSource.description: The authority that produced this decision. Legacy records predate this field and deserialize as `user`, which is the only decision source they could persist.

BackgroundTaskKind.description: v1 only has shell background tasks; new kinds are backward-compatible variant additions.

oneOf.description: Agent scheduled via `compact.run` / `host_request` (turn-end).

ContextCategoryId.description: Category buckets for model-visible context occupancy.

ContextCategoryUsage.description: One category's share of the current context window occupancy.

shareBps.description: Share in basis points (0..=10_000); categories sum to 10_000 when `total_tokens > 0`.

ContextOccupancy.description:
Category breakdown of how full the effective context window is.

Distinct from billing usage: this answers "what fills the window", not "how much was spent".

Context-window occupancy snapshot (distinct from billing usage, see the usage module). `measured = false` marks parts that were not precisely metered.

Used on compaction items (`before` / `after`). Prefer [`ContextOccupancy`] for `context/usage/read` and `context/usageUpdated`.

ExecOrigin.description: Who initiated a command execution: a model tool call, or the user's `!` shell escape.

FileChangeEntry.description: One file touched by a write/edit/patch tool call.

GitInfo.description: Snapshot semantics: the current value is *copied* into the record at observation time; later changes to the source do not affect the copy.

dirty.description: `None` = unknown (e.g. converted from legacy data that never recorded the dirty flag); fresh snapshots always compute it.

progressSummary.description: Human-readable progress summary; no percentage (a value that cannot be honestly computed does not enter the protocol).

GoalStatus.description: State machine: `active ⇄ paused / blocked / usageLimited / budgetLimited` (the latter two are NOT terminal — topping up quota or resuming returns to `active`); terminal states are `completed / failed / canceled`.

clientUserMessageId.description: Domain-level dedup key: the same logical message materializes only once across steer/queue races and RPC retries.

entry.description: Records the path this message actually took (absorbs the legacy `SteerInput` variant). Input still sitting in the queue is not yet an item of any turn.

oneOf.description: The provider's encrypted reasoning payload is stored by reference and re-attached when building outbound context.
Typed projection of the `update_plan` tool: the tool call/result pair remains the replay truth (hidden from display); this variant is the single UI-facing plan truth and evolves over the whole turn.

callId.description: Tool-call id when this plan item came from an `update_plan` call. Clients key the running tool row by call id; without it the plan completion cannot be correlated and the row stays open forever. `None` for proposed-plan markdown (plan mode) and legacy persisted items written before the field existed.

displayContent.description: Compressed UI rendering; does not change replay semantics.

oneOf.description: Specialized result variant for the exec tool family (`exec_command`/`write_stdin`). Model-initiated shell calls are the majority; user `!` commands land in the same variant with `origin = userShell`. Displaying the command plus prompt replay needs the original model input, hence a dedicated variant.
Generalizes the legacy `WebSearch`/`ImageGeneration` variants: future provider-hosted tools (code_interpreter, ...) need zero protocol changes; clients render by `tool_name`.

One logical approval interaction = one item (merges the legacy `ApprovalRequest` + `ApprovalDecision` pair); `decision = None` is the waiting state, filled in place on response.

commandPrefix.description: Suggested command prefix for persistent exec-policy approval.

targetItemId.description: Points at the action item being approved (CommandExecution/FileChange/ToolCall).

v1 keeps exactly three variants: the legacy `Review` kind was dead code and an open `Other(String)` variant breaks exhaustive client matching.

oneOf.description: Goal-driven autonomous turn. Has no user message by design and is not steerable; only `Regular + InProgress` turns may be steered.

TurnRecovery.description: A saved turn can be recoverable without any live execution task.

oneOf.description: Execution is paused until a first-party approval decision arrives.

TurnUsage.description: Split so that "how much did this turn cost" and "the bill" reconcile: `query` covers only `TurnQuery`; `overhead` covers the turn's `AutoReview + Compaction`.

oneOf.description: Main loop, including model retries and post-tool follow-ups.
Model reviewer before approval.
History compaction summary.
Session title generation.
Continual Harness refine planning (`L2-DES-HARNESS-001`).
Mid-tool Python cell wait-policy decision.

UsageTotals.description: Aggregated token/call totals. `call_count` includes failed and cancelled attempts; `metered_call_count` counts attempts with reported usage.

totalTokens.description: Aggregate tokens. For ledger-derived totals this equals `input_tokens + output_tokens`; for legacy lumps it is the only known number (the input/output split was never recorded).

UserInput.description: One submission = one `UserMessage` item whose content is a list of parts.

oneOf.description: Experimental; not part of the v1 guaranteed modalities.

UserMessageEntry.description: How a user message entered the system.

oneOf.description: Submitted while idle; immediately started a new turn.
Submitted while busy into the queue; started its own turn when drained.
Injected into a running turn (including promotion from the queue).

currentVersion.description: Current resource version when reporting a version conflict.

details.description: Must never contain secrets or restricted content.

requiresSnapshot.description: Whether the client must re-fetch a snapshot before retrying.

decisionSource.description: The authority that produced this decision. Legacy records predate this field and deserialize as `user`, which is the only decision source they could persist.

BackgroundTaskKind.description: v1 only has shell background tasks; new kinds are backward-compatible variant additions.

oneOf.description: Agent scheduled via `compact.run` / `host_request` (turn-end).

ContextCategoryId.description: Category buckets for model-visible context occupancy.

ContextCategoryUsage.description: One category's share of the current context window occupancy.

shareBps.description: Share in basis points (0..=10_000); categories sum to 10_000 when `total_tokens > 0`.

ContextOccupancy.description:
Category breakdown of how full the effective context window is.

Distinct from billing usage: this answers "what fills the window", not "how much was spent".

ContextUsage.description:
Context-window occupancy snapshot (distinct from billing usage, see the usage module). `measured = false` marks parts that were not precisely metered.

Used on compaction items (`before` / `after`). Prefer [`ContextOccupancy`] for `context/usage/read` and `context/usageUpdated`.

ExecOrigin.description: Who initiated a command execution: a model tool call, or the user's `!` shell escape.

FileChangeEntry.description: One file touched by a write/edit/patch tool call.

GitInfo.description: Snapshot semantics: the current value is *copied* into the record at observation time; later changes to the source do not affect the copy.

dirty.description: `None` = unknown (e.g. converted from legacy data that never recorded the dirty flag); fresh snapshots always compute it.

progressSummary.description: Human-readable progress summary; no percentage (a value that cannot be honestly computed does not enter the protocol).

GoalStatus.description: State machine: `active ⇄ paused / blocked / usageLimited / budgetLimited` (the latter two are NOT terminal — topping up quota or resuming returns to `active`); terminal states are `completed / failed / canceled`.

clientUserMessageId.description: Domain-level dedup key: the same logical message materializes only once across steer/queue races and RPC retries.

entry.description: Records the path this message actually took (absorbs the legacy `SteerInput` variant). Input still sitting in the queue is not yet an item of any turn.

oneOf.description: The provider's encrypted reasoning payload is stored by reference and re-attached when building outbound context.
Typed projection of the `update_plan` tool: the tool call/result pair remains the replay truth (hidden from display); this variant is the single UI-facing plan truth and evolves over the whole turn.

callId.description: Tool-call id when this plan item came from an `update_plan` call. Clients key the running tool row by call id; without it the plan completion cannot be correlated and the row stays open forever. `None` for proposed-plan markdown (plan mode) and legacy persisted items written before the field existed.

displayContent.description: Compressed UI rendering; does not change replay semantics.

oneOf.description: Specialized result variant for the exec tool family (`exec_command`/`write_stdin`). Model-initiated shell calls are the majority; user `!` commands land in the same variant with `origin = userShell`. Displaying the command plus prompt replay needs the original model input, hence a dedicated variant.
Generalizes the legacy `WebSearch`/`ImageGeneration` variants: future provider-hosted tools (code_interpreter, ...) need zero protocol changes; clients render by `tool_name`.
Specialized result for the write/edit/patch tool family. Per-file granularity (one apply_patch may touch many files), approval is per change, and a stable item lets diff-review UIs update in place.
One logical approval interaction = one item (merges the legacy `ApprovalRequest` + `ApprovalDecision` pair); `decision = None` is the waiting state, filled in place on response.

commandPattern.description: Normalized command pattern used by session-scoped approval labels.

commandPrefix.description: Suggested command prefix for persistent exec-policy approval.

targetItemId.description: Points at the action item being approved (CommandExecution/FileChange/ToolCall).

oneOf.description: Structured questions from a tool (options/forms). Must be persisted so pending questions survive reconnect/resume and remain answerable.
Not merged into `BackgroundTask`: the control planes are disjoint (process stdin/stdout vs. a full session's message channel and permission inheritance). Both share `SpawnedWorkState`.

command.description: User `!` shell command text when `task_kind` is `Shell`.

output.description: Retained stdout/stderr tail for resume / task reads.

oneOf.description: Human-readable milestone summary only; no percentage — a value that cannot be honestly computed does not enter the protocol.
Continual Harness refine outcome (L2-DES-HARNESS-001). Not a memory browser.
Non-fatal events (model retry, capability downgrade, quota pressure) that must leave a trace without failing the turn.
Summary of an abandoned branch after in-session tree navigate (`branch_summary` item). Tree-visible; parent is the new leaf.

sessionId.description: Owning session: lets subscribers route child-session deltas (subagent monitor) instead of folding them into the main transcript.

ItemEnvelope.description: Persistence-and-event shared header for every item. The item payload does not embed an id; identity, ordering, revision and the common lifecycle state live here.

parentId.description: Parent in the session transcript tree (`None` = root). Legacy lines omit the field; readers infer a linear chain by `seq` when missing.

revision.description: Strictly increasing per `id`; `1` on first appearance. Readers fold updates by `(id, revision)`.

seq.description: Sequence position assigned on first appearance; strictly increasing within a session. Later updates reuse the same `seq`.

ItemState.description: Common delivery lifecycle of an item, owned by the envelope. Variants must not duplicate their own status field (linked-work state on `SubAgent`/`BackgroundTask` describes the external work, not delivery).

variant.description: Optional named variant from the provider model directory.

ModelQueryRetryPhase.description: Phase of a provider retry cycle (ratified vocabulary, L2-DES-APP-009 DD-3): a retry is first `Scheduled`, then `Resumed` when the next attempt starts.

oneOf.description: Promoted out of the queue into the running turn as a steer.
Dequeued to start its own new turn.

input.description: Full editable content; `session/queue/update` replaces it wholesale.

preview.description: Short single-line preview for list rendering.

ReasoningEffort.description: OpenAI models support reasoning effort. See <https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/reasoning?api-mode=responses#get-started-with-reasoning>

SandboxExecutionSummary.description: Compact description of how a sandboxed execution ran.

escalated.description: Whether the execution ran outside the sandbox after approval.

schedule.description: Cron / "every 5m"-style expression when [`Self::kind`] is Cron or when the heartbeat was created from a schedule string.

activeTurnId.description: Invariant: `status == Active` iff `active_turn_id.is_some()`; updated atomically by the single session actor.

activity.description: Agents View / list tray activity. Server-maintained from `status` + `flags` so clients do not re-derive (L2-DES-RLM-001 Agents View).

additionalDirectories.description: Additional absolute workspace roots associated with the session.

atTurnId.description: Cut turn for a user fork (`through` that turn); absent for tip forks.

cwd.description: Execution scope of the session: normalized absolute path. It is part of the session's identity, not the client's location; resuming from a different cwd does not change it.

flags.description: Stackable blocking reasons; deduplicated and serialized in enum order so equivalent snapshots produce stable JSON.

forkFromId.description: Source session when this session was created by user `session/fork`.

gitInfo.description: Computed at creation and recomputed on `session/cwd/change`; clients treat it as potentially stale.

messageCount.description: Approximate user+assistant item count for list / Agents View trays. Optional so older snapshots and non-list reads stay compact.

model.description: Current binding: what the next turn will use.

parent.description: Sub-agent parent only. User forks use `fork_from_id` instead.

queuedCount.description: The queue is session state, not turn state.

summary.description: Idle-session summary line for Agents View (may be stale).

taskState.description: Coarse task/agent state label when known (`idle`, `working`, …).

transcriptSizeBytes.description: Current on-disk size of the durable JSONL transcript. This is a list-view cache: servers may omit it from non-list responses or when the session has no readable rollout file.

usage.description: Redundant aggregate of turn usages for list views; the ledger wins on any disagreement.

SessionActivity.description: List / Agents View activity. Derived from [`SessionStatus`] + [`SessionFlag`] on the server (`Session::sync_activity`) so first-party clients read it directly from Native wire — no client-side projection adapters.

SessionFlag.description: Blocking reasons, stackable on top of `status`. "Waiting" is a flag, not a status: clients can tell "working" apart from "blocked on you".

oneOf.description: A pending approval request.
An unanswered structured question.
Compaction in progress.
Goal-internal orchestration in progress.

SessionParent.description: Sub-agent parentage only. User forks use `Session.fork_from_id` / `Session.at_turn_id` so list/delete/resume treat them as independent parallel history rather than child executors.

autoRefineEnabled.description: Root auto-refine enable (default on when unset). Persist-first via patch.

autoRefineTurnInterval.description: Successful user-visible turns between auto-refine runs (default 25).

effectiveContextWindow.description: Session override for the absolute effective context window (tokens). When set, takes precedence over the model-derived effective window and is clamped to `model.context_window` at resolve time. Also drives the automatic-compaction boundary.

mode.description: ACP-style session mode id, if one is active.

pythonCellFirstWaitMs.description: First foreground wait (ms) before Python cell wait-policy. Default 180_000 when unset.

reasoningEffort.description: User's reasoning-effort selection as persisted, including the toggle keywords `on`/`off` used by toggle/variant-style models — the typed `ReasoningEffort` enum cannot express those, so the snapshot carries the raw selection string (same contract as `SessionSettingsPatch.reasoning_effort`).

sandboxProfile.description: Active sandbox profile description; needed to restore the sandbox when resuming the session.

oneOf.description: Truncated first user message applied before optional LLM polish.

SessionUsage.description: Derived cache aggregated from the usage ledger (truth = ledger sum). Exists solely so list views need not page through turn details; on any disagreement the ledger wins.

legacy.description: Pre-upgrade historical totals that cannot be decomposed into calls; not disguised as call records. `total = legacy + ledger`.

SpawnedWorkState.description: State of spawned external work referenced by `SubAgent`/`BackgroundTask`. Distinct from the parent item envelope's delivery lifecycle. `Lost` makes spawned work whose terminal state cannot be confirmed after a runtime restart recognizable instead of pretending it completed.

collaborationMode.description: Collaboration mode captured for this turn. Older servers may omit it; clients may then fall back to the session's current mode.

model.description: Snapshot: the binding this turn actually ran with. `session.model` may change afterwards; history must faithfully answer "what did this turn run with".

oneOf.description: Execution is paused until a first-party approval decision arrives.

TurnUsage.description: Split so that "how much did this turn cost" and "the bill" reconcile: `query` covers only `TurnQuery`; `overhead` covers the turn's `AutoReview + Compaction`.
